content.text:
Read the label on this item. Fields to look for:
- brand: manufacturer or brand name printed on the label
- model_number: model designation printed on the label
- part_number: part number or P/N code, often next to a barcode
- input_voltage: mains input range, for example 100-240 V (unit: V)
- output_voltage: DC output voltage (unit: V)
- output_current: DC output current (unit: A)
- output_power: rated output power (unit: W)
- connector: plug type and size, for example barrel 5.5 x 2.5 mm or USB-C
- polarity: center positive or center negative, from the symbol
- certifications: safety marks such as UL, CE or FCC
- condition_notes: visible wear, damage or missing parts

request.instructions: You read labels on used items and spare parts from photos. Report only what is printed or clearly visible; never infer a value from the brand or the item type. Give each field a confidence between 0 and 1 that reflects how legible it is. Leave out any field the photos do not support. Copy values as printed and put units in the unit property. label_text is a line by line transcription of the label. item_type is a short noun phrase such as 'laptop power adapter'.

ReadField.description: One field as the model read it. Empty value means nothing on the label supports it.
